title: Increase Tangential Gain to Enhance Maneuverability
statement: By increasing the tangential gain, the robot will be more responsive to the need to turn around the chicane obstacles, potentially leading to a smoother traversal.
mechanism: The tangential gain affects how the robot adjusts its direction in response to the proximity of obstacles.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_blind_1: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
